acceptance_stage: early source proofs only; not final atlas acceptance
decision: The inspected cardinal and running-right faces fix the old elongated flat-jaw/profile defect while retaining the same character and readable direction. No concrete source-art blocker was found in these proofs.
method: Compared the actual native-size cardinal and running-right panels with the old native diagnosis and canonical character. Enlarged nearest-neighbor head proofs confirmed cheek/chin shape, eye foreshortening, and facial-feature placement. No true 90-degree profile or uniform mathematical angular spacing was required.

old_face_geometry_defect.evidence: The new sideward cardinal and running-right faces have rounded cheeks, tiny noses, and short, softly curved chins. They no longer show the old long horizontal lower jaw, projecting chin, or one-eye full-profile face.

canonical_identity_and_style.evidence: The large violet eyes, compact round face, pale skin, white/lavender fringe, horns, and attached rosette remain consistent with the canonical character. The new turned faces read as the same character rather than an alternate profile design.

two_eye_three_quarter_structure.evidence: Both eyes remain visible in the left and right cardinal faces and running-right frames. The farther eye is reduced and partly framed by the fringe, so the face retains a turned three-quarter structure rather than appearing as a frontal face pasted into a side head.

left_right_cardinal_semantics.evidence: The opposite cheek/nose turn, eye presentation, and gaze distinguish screen-right from screen-left at native size. The poses are milder than the old full profiles, but the intended left/right direction is still readable. Up and down remain clear.

head_scale_and_body_fit.evidence: The head remains compact and appropriately sized for the same body. The cardinal heads and running-right heads do not show a conspicuous scale jump, neck disconnection, or change to the overall chibi proportions.

running_right_face_continuity.evidence: All eight heads retain the same short-chin face and eye design. Small changes in head tilt and eye exposure read as natural movement; no frame returns to the old protruding profile jaw or a conspicuously different face.

running_right_direction_and_gait.evidence: The forward lean and three-quarter-right face, with hair/robe/tail trailing behind, clearly read as moving right. Alternating lifted, lowered, and forward-reaching legs make a plausible running sequence; no conspicuous malformed limb or ungrounded gait pose is visible in the native ordered panel.

rosette_and_costume_identity.evidence: The rosette remains attached at anatomical left in the cardinal views. The same horns, wings, robe, and curled scaled tail support character identity through the running-right row.

uncertainty: This review covers the four cardinal proofs and the running-right row, not all intermediate gaze cells or the running-left row.
The exact final atlas, combined transitions between all 32 new and 41 preserved cells, final registration, and final clipping have not yet been reviewed.
Visible green outline residue is expected in these pre-despill proofs. Its successful final cleanup must be checked on the exact final PNG; it is not treated as a source face-shape failure here.
